snippet.title: Trollheim: Gnomes - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the announcement trailer for Trollheim: Gnomes, an upcoming co-op PVE survival crafting adventure game. Trollheim: Gnomes will be available on PC.
Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players.
The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real. Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.


#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
